primary_failure.interpretation: The retained failure proves the public release was indeterminate. It does not identify which guarded branch or normalized IPC/native failure produced it. The cleanup assertion is secondary, not the explanation for release.

crash_log.interpretation: Signal-time main-thread dump, not a retained release exception or deadline measurement. SIGTERM may be normal Host drain/failure retirement; its trigger is not established by this artifact.

existing_container_inspections.interpretation: Historical source bytes privately parsed, not fresh Docker calls. Exit 0/no OOM for the retired Host do not prove a successful native release.

proved_source_behavior.finding: handle converts RuntimeUnavailable into CatalogError TASK_INDETERMINATE with from None, discarding the client reason.

Before release, boot mismatch and an already-reserved release also raise TASK_INDETERMINATE. The v4 release commits intent, obtains the original grant, holds native_preparation_commit and calls the existing RuntimeClient._exchange. Retained artifacts do not independently select among these branches.

Client checks authority/connection/frame budget, writes/drains, reads one reply and validates identity/state/fence/inventory. Refusal, timeout, transport/decoding and reply/fence validation errors inside the exchange are collapsed to Runtime exchange unavailable. No retained release exchange observation preserves the original reason.

Host validates managed input/authority/deadline, invokes its existing NativePeer and validates the final before memory retention. ValueError/OSError/TimeoutError/protocol failures are collapsed to RUNTIME_DENIED. Managed finals are Host-process memory only; after retirement they cannot be recovered from the two retained lock files.
Native stderr is discarded. Native error replies preserve only numeric RPCError.code for the Host; detailed native error text is not retained by NativePeer. RPC timeouts become Native RPC deadline.

The existing handshake observer monkeypatches source-process NativePeer, but H03 runs Host/NativePeer in a separate stock installed process. Its empty launch_diagnostic is therefore not an absence-of-errors proof. Public stage BOUND and the recorded stock native child prove progress beyond initial readiness.

bounded_frontier_checks.evidence: Historical Docker configuration is user 1000:1000/stock CMD. Source start_host attests public installed bytes via the exact Host mount namespace; reaching BOUND follows those guards.
bounded_frontier_checks.conclusion: No concrete pre-import UID/COPY failure is evidenced. Release-time native failure remains unclassified.

bounded_frontier_checks.evidence: SubagentLifecycleService.stage creates constructor-owned ContractState and freezes assignment before BOUND. agent/contract_execution.py:179-180 reads the staged immutable input bytes, not an external CASE_SLOT filesystem path. Live root, child, binding and deadline guards are rechecked at release/read/PURE.
bounded_frontier_checks.conclusion: No evidence supports a filesystem case-root accessibility explanation for this release. No retained observation proves the live release guards passed.

bounded_frontier_checks.evidence: InstanceService.runtime_authority uses DB lease remaining capped at 4.5s mapped onto producer monotonic time. Client managed budget is min(3.2s, remaining). Host checks its current grant before accepting the new one; native batch is 4.5s and execution guard 3.0s.
bounded_frontier_checks.conclusion: Grant/batch/execution deadline expiry is possible, not measured. No release entry/exit/grant-remainder counters survive; do not extend deadlines based on this investigation.

bounded_frontier_checks.evidence: SOURCE runs Host in the pytest process and launches the native entry through the bootstrap/import overlays/observer; H03 runs the fixed installed Host/native command in the owned OCI namespace with fixed native environment. Both use the same domain release owner and private protocol, but observation, interpreter/library routing and process boundary differ.
bounded_frontier_checks.conclusion: SOURCE success does not establish why the first installed release failed. No measured failure supports a product/distribution/source patch.

secondary_cleanup_finding.mechanism: The absence check treats any nonempty stdout as uncertainty. Docker inspect formatter emits a newline even when the exact CID is absent, so the byte string is truthy.
secondary_cleanup_finding.effect: Independent false uncertainty at cleanup/absence. Can contribute to H03_CLEANUP_NOT_SETTLED masking the primary error and DB retention; not a cause of TASK_INDETERMINATE.
secondary_cleanup_finding.limit: Parent separately measured current daemon absence and owns any correction. Body-failure/other uncertainty latches must still retain DB; fixing this predicate does not reconcile the failed release.

missing_finite_measurement.first_question: Did the original release refuse before IPC, receive a correlated Host denial, fail while writing/reading, or reject an otherwise received reply?
missing_finite_measurement.minimal_original_observer_correction: In the existing source-owned exchange observer, checkpoint release attempt and exact-code pre-normalization failure before RuntimeClient._exchange collapses it and before NativeTaskOwner.handle masks it. Keep the same original RuntimeClient, connection, owner, grant and one send. An outer wrapper observing only Runtime exchange unavailable is insufficient.
sanitized_fields: original exception class, trusted module/line and finite allowlisted reason code
reply ok/state and typed epoch/generation match booleans, never reply bytes
missing_finite_measurement.if_host_denial_is_localized: Before any separately authorized exact-owned retirement, retain bounded private existing Host/Docker diagnostics and, only if needed, one finite exact-code observation of the existing Host managed/native call's original exception/RPC code and trusted allowlisted denial reason. Host RUNTIME_DENIED alone cannot distinguish native rejection from grant/state/response checks.
do_not_capture: raw native stdout/stderr in tool output
missing_finite_measurement.constraints: No third framework/owner, no second RuntimeClient, no retries/resends, no prewarming, no deadline/lease/image/product changes, no identical uninstrumented rerun. A future observation is a distinct authorized attempt, never retrospective proof of this one.
